quote.text: Time is the longest distance between two places.
quote.author: Tennessee Williams, The Glass Menagerie (1944), scene seven

stories.headline: Jensen Huang apologises to Nvidia staff; Senate sets 3 December hearing
stories.dek: Nvidia’s shares gave back 5.8 per cent on 24 November, to $155.49, a day after a 31.5 per cent jump; the Senate Banking committee will question Huang on chip exports.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Auffret At Phillips
stories.headline: Théo Auffret’s Paris tourbillon sells for HK$12.19m at Phillips
stories.dek: Phillips’ Hong Kong sale of 21–22 November made HK$601.2 million, every one of its 325 lots sold; the Auffret was estimated at HK$0.9–1.8 million.

stories.headline: Vietnam takes its first Culture Day off, for one day
stories.dek: In Hanoi, the Ministry of Home Affairs had proposed a four-day break from 21 to 24 November to “boost consumer spending”; ten days later it withdrew the plan, citing year-end factory orders.

stories.headline: Russia warns Estonia over drones, citing “open war”
stories.dek: Moscow’s foreign ministry summoned Estonia’s envoy on 23 November, three days after Tallinn voted to shut all five road crossings into Russia from 1 December.

stories.headline: Singapore and Australia sign a carbon-storage treaty
stories.dek: Lawrence Wong and Anthony Albanese also widened their emergency-supplies pact to ten classes of goods on 24 November, including food and chips.

stories.kicker: The Atelier · Candles, Wax And Wick
stories.headline: Danish EPA finds refined paraffin candles shed fewest particles
stories.dek: In June Estée Lauder took over a UK factory of Contract Candles, the firm that has poured Jo Malone and Tom Ford candles; Trudon’s 270g Classic now costs US$155.

stories.headline: Vivo’s V80 reaches Singapore at S$899 with Apple Watch sync
stories.dek: Pre-orders run from 20 to 26 November and shops sell it from 27 November; the 7,200mAh phone lists at S$999 after a S$100 launch discount ends on 31 December.

stories.headline: Disney’s Hexed and Focker-In-Law open for Thanksgiving
stories.dek: Both open in America today, each tracked at US$40–50 million over five days; Hexed reaches Singapore on 26 November.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · Fruit, Fish And Crohn’s
stories.headline: Gut study links teenage fruit to 64% less Crohn’s
stories.dek: The pooled study of 111,999 Norwegian, Danish and Swedish children found 653 cases of inflammatory bowel disease; fruit at seven was also tied to more colitis.

stories.headline: Brent crude falls to $88 on signs of US–Iran diplomacy
stories.dek: Oil has lost about a quarter since its 30 October close above $117; on 24 November American consumers’ year-ahead inflation guess fell to 5.7 per cent.

stories.headline: Guinness confirms David Rush’s 31.8km juggling skate
stories.dek: The Idaho record-hunter kept three balls up along the Boise Greenbelt; Guinness confirmed it on 23 November, a year after the run, at more than six times the old mark.

stories.headline: Mayo Clinic Proceedings review ranks fitness above diet for longevity
stories.dek: Arizona State’s Glenn Gaesser and Kaiser Permanente’s Robert Sallis found the worst diets carried 3–20 per cent higher mortality, all-day sitting 46 to over 163 per cent.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Horrible Histories And Dinosaurs
stories.headline: KidsFest brings Horrible Histories to Singapore’s Drama Centre
stories.dek: Two shows run from 29 to 31 January at S$42–72; in Ueno, Tokyo, the Dinosaur Expo opens on 13 March with Japan’s first look at Costensuchus.
